descriptionHtml:
Bug B02 · P0 · new

Unsaved dictation audio and transcripts stay in the browser's storage after sign-out and after account deletion; a second physician signing in on the same browser gets no prompt, but the data is on the device

Tickets: TFA-94745 ready for qa; TFA-92570 AC 7 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Note: Was a decision item; reclassified as a bug (PHI exposure). Daniela to confirm what sign-out must clear Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92570/94745): the second physician sees no Recover prompt (that cell passed); sign-out and account deletion both call only clearAllDrafts (SettingsModal.tsx:111, :138), which leaves the recording store. After a successful save the whole text also stays in the draft store until sign-out (TC-10/S29 c). Whether P0 still fits is a question for Quinn.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-02/S16, OAT-03/S24, EFS/S20

Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S25 Dictated audio kept on the device is gone after Save Note and after sign-out

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T8 Dictated audio and transcripts kept on the device are removed once their note is saved and on sign-out, and are never kept past the retention window; … (TFA-92570 AC 7; TFA-94745 AC 7; TFA-94745 Quinn 2026-10-05 comment; UAT 3.6 retention claim)
  • T9 A live session that fails to connect is retried once; one that drops mid-dictation keeps its recording and transcribes it once with whisper-1, the audio is kept until the transcript is in the field, … (TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-94745 AC 6; TFA-94745 Quinn 2026-10-05 comment)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Same setup as S01; Hospital pre-round box and Nursing Home Pre-Round box; the app keeps each live recording, with its transcript, in IndexedDB 'round-ai-local-audio' until its text is in the field

When (1) Dictate H-03, let it land, Save Note; (2) dictate H-03 with the S08 E-4 drop and leave it unsaved; (3) sign out; (4) sign back in as the same physician, then as a second physician in the same browser; dump IndexedDB 'round-ai-local-audio' (and 'roundcompanion-session-drafts') after each step; …

Then After (1): no row for that field. During (2): at most the one kept recording for the dropped take, keyed to its own patient and field. After (3): no row in 'round-ai-local-audio'. After (4): the second physician sees no Recover notice and no row from the first. No row is ever older than the 36 h retention window

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): T8 (TFA-92570 AC 7, TFA-94745 AC 7 and Quinn's 2026-10-05 comment: only the unsaved tail is kept and it is wiped on sign-out or account deletion; UAT 3.6 retention claim) and T9 (audio kept until its transcript is in the field). On main localAudio.ts never reads createdAt, nothing expires rows, ids carry no user, and sign-out clears only the drafts store, so step (3) is expect …

Where it ran: local aicheck-dictation (dictation AI checks); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S25 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-23.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Daniela) · environment local · tickets TFA-92570 ready for qa; TFA-94745 ready for qa

Dictation audio and transcripts from unsaved or cut-off takes stay on the device after the physician signs out and are still there when another physician signs in on the same browser.

Evidence: allure-results/3302a469…: 7/14 pass. After sign-out, IndexedDB 'round-ai-local-audio' still holds Hospital rows (a dropped take of 51 KB, and a landed-but-unsaved take of 137 KB plus a 70-char transcript) and an NH dropped take. They are still there when a second physician signs in; sign-out clears only the drafts store. This is the open PHI-at-rest question TC-23 Q17 / EFS Q5, which needs Daniela's sign-off.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane aicheck-dictation.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: aicheck-dictation.

UAT item: TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-23/S25

Tickets: TFA-92570 Mobile: Capacitor wrap for App Store & Google Play (ready for qa); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

How it is tested (aicheck-dictation/plan.json, automatable: yes): scripted far end, prepareSession stubbed; Hospital H-03 and NH N-03: (1) dictate, land, Save Note, dump IndexedDB 'round-ai-local-audio' (keys, createdAt, sizes, transcript length only); (2) dictate with the data channel closed mid-take and transcribeAudio failing at the socket, leave unsaved; (2b) on a second chart, an ordinary dictation that lands and is not saved (record what the device keeps); (3) sign out via Settings and judge both kept rows separately; (4) sign in as the same physician, then as a second fresh physician in the same browser profile; dump after each step; Recover notice for the second physician. One retry with new accounts when the local backend was unreachable or timing out. — Storage behaviour is the app's own; the kept recording is real audio from the shim. 36 h cell needs the aging helper (not run).

Scripted far end, prepareSession stubbed; the recordings kept on the device are the shim's real audio (MediaRecorder). NH (3) after sign-out: the dropped take's kept recording is gone (rows [{"key":"snf:m5791a2ekdzt04hsdwmje9nne98g9prk:pre-round","audioBytes":38281,"transcriptChars":0,"ageMin":1}]); NH (3) after sign-out: no row at all in round-ai-local-audio (rows [{"key":"snf:m5791a2ekdzt04hsdwmje9nne98g9prk:pre-round","audioBytes":38281,"transcriptChars":0,"ageMin":1}]); NH (4) second physician: no row from the first physician on the device (rows from the first physician's charts [{"key":"snf:m5791a2ekdzt04hsdwmje9nne98g9prk:pre-round","audioBytes":38281,"transcriptChars":0,"ageMin":1}]); not decided here: 36 h cell (no row older than 36 h) needs the aging helper, not on main Record-only (needs a decision): H (2b) landed, unsaved dictation: what the device keeps (record-only) — landed true; row for that field {"key":"rounding:kx7a87571vrbeqyywcfmgfckh58g8fgr:pre-round:note","audioBytes":137149,"transcriptChars":70,"ageMin":0}; on screen ["Audio backup is stored on this device until Save Note succeeds."]; NH (2b) landed, unsaved dictation: what the device keeps (record-only) — landed true; row for that field none; on screen []. prepareSession: 6 call(s), 6 stubbed at the socket, 0 real OpenAI mint(s) with …PUMA. Build e02167f; aiProvider:_current {"model":"us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0","provider":"bedrock","transcription":"gpt-live","visionModel":"gemini-2.5-flash","visionProvider":"vertex"}.

Product issue: Dictation audio stays on the device after sign-out. Hospital: an ordinary dictation that landed in the pre-round box and was not saved (its recording and its transcript; the Hospital editor says 'Audio backup is stored on this device until Save Note succeeds') and a dictation that was cut off and not yet recovered (its recording) stay in IndexedDB 'round-ai-local-audio' after the physician signs out, and are still on the device when a second physician signs in on the same browser. Nursing Home: a dictation that was cut off and not yet recovered (its recording) stays in IndexedDB 'round-ai-local-audio' after the physician signs out, and is still on the device when a second physician signs in on the same browser. Sign-out (SettingsModal) clears only the drafts store and the kept rows carry no user. Breaks TFA-92570 AC 7 / TFA-94745 AC 7 (only the unsaved tail is kept and it is wiped on sign-out) and the UAT 3.6 retention claim.

Evidence: 12 attached; 1 not attached:

  • aicheck-dictation/artifacts/20261014-fix-client-2/pw/tc23-client-TC-23-S25-dict-47d60-ave-Note-and-after-sign-out-dictation/trace.zip — .zip files are not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane B (dictation-ai runner, not built): it plays a fixed synthetic voice into the app's own Dictate through a getUserMedia shim (no real microphone or speaker) on a fresh @roundai.test account, spending the local OpenAI key (laneB-preconditions).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
